signs.name: Aries
signs.traits: Cardinal masculine fire sign, ruled by Mars, First House of the self. Vivacious, enthusiastic, impulsive, hotheaded, quick-thinking, leader energy; symbol the Ram.

signs.name: Taurus
signs.traits: Fixed feminine earth sign, ruled by Venus, Second House of value. Sensual, great taste, stubborn, stabilizing, stamina; symbol the Bull.

signs.name: Gemini
signs.traits: Mutable masculine air sign, ruled by Mercury, Third House of communication. Witty, restless, dual-minded, curious, overbooked; symbol the Twins.

signs.name: Cancer
signs.traits: Cardinal feminine water sign, ruled by the Moon, Fourth House of home. Intuitive, nurturing, moody, protective; symbol the Crab.

signs.name: Leo
signs.traits: Fixed masculine fire sign, ruled by the Sun, Fifth House of joy and creativity. Bold, dramatic, warm, loves the spotlight; symbol the Lion.

signs.name: Virgo
signs.traits: Mutable feminine earth sign, ruled by Mercury, Sixth House of work and routine. Detail-oriented, perfectionist, dependable, critical; symbol the Virgin.

signs.name: Libra
signs.traits: Cardinal masculine air sign, ruled by Venus, Seventh House of partnership. Seeks balance, social, can be indecisive; symbol the Scales.

signs.name: Scorpio
signs.traits: Fixed feminine water sign, co-ruled by Mars and Pluto, Eighth House of transformation. Intense, deep, secretive, fierce; symbol the Scorpion.

signs.name: Sagittarius
signs.traits: Mutable masculine fire sign, ruled by Jupiter, Ninth House of exploration. Expressive, opinionated, lucky, wanderlust; symbol the Centaur.

signs.name: Capricorn
signs.traits: Cardinal feminine earth sign, ruled by Saturn, Tenth House of career. Stoic, ambitious, long-game, authority; symbol the Sea-Goat.

signs.name: Aquarius
signs.traits: Fixed masculine air sign, ruled by Saturn and Uranus, Eleventh House of community. Innovative, individualistic, cool exterior, collective-minded; symbol the Water-Bearer.

signs.name: Pisces
signs.traits: Mutable feminine water sign, co-ruled by Jupiter and Neptune, Twelfth House of the subconscious. Dreamy, intuitive, fluid, sometimes confused; symbol two Fish.
